sources.deal: Filled from the application and the listing. The agent confirms it.
sources.manager: A building or company default, set once in admin settings.
sources.agent: The agent types this in for each lease.
sources._needs_setup: Fields marked needs_setup have no default because the source lease left them blank. A manager has to supply a value before the first lease is generated.
sources._scope: manager fields carry a scope: 'company' settings are the same everywhere; 'building' settings differ per building and their defaults came from one specific building, so review them before reusing.
sources._source_value: Removed. It held what the one real lease this template was built from actually said — a landlord entity, an escrow bank, a payee address and phone — which is that landlord's and that tenancy's data, not a default. The find/replace table it came from now lives outside the repository, in notes/template-rules.json.

rule_kinds._: Rules describe what the template asks for that a field on its own cannot say: a disclosure that must have exactly one box ticked, a date that only means something under one of them. Nothing here blocks generation - a checkbox is answered by definition, and an unticked disclosure prints as an empty box rather than as a gap. That is precisely why they are written down: they are the errors a finished lease carries out of the door quietly.
rule_kinds.one_of: Exactly one of `fields` must be ticked. The form says so in words - 'check one', 'please select only one'.
rule_kinds.any_of: At least one of `fields` must be ticked, and more than one may be.
rule_kinds.required_when: While `when` is ticked, every field in `then` needs a value; the sentence around it reads as a blank otherwise.
rule_kinds.blank_unless: Unless `when` is ticked, every field in `then` has to be empty - the clause that would carry it is switched off.
rule_kinds.idle_unless: While `when_filled` is empty, `then` has to sit at `idle`. The template prints these as a row, so a payer with no utility named is a row asserting nothing.
rule_kinds.when: required_when and blank_unless test `when`: it is the box the rule is about.
rule_kinds.only_when: one_of and any_of carrying `only_when` are asked only while that box is ticked. The Good Cause form branches, and a branch nobody is standing in has no unanswered questions.

rules.label: Sprinkler disclosure
rules.why: RPL § 231-a makes the landlord say whether the premises has a sprinkler system. Neither box ticked prints the notice with two empty boxes and discloses nothing.

rules.label: Sprinkler last inspected
rules.why: Option 2 ends 'was maintained and inspected was on ____'. With no date the sentence stops mid-air.

rules.label: Bedbug infestation history
rules.why: The form says only checked boxes apply, so no box checked is a disclosure that says nothing at all.

rules.label: Vacancy or renewal lease
rules.why: 'Please select only one.' Nothing computes this today, so it is blank unless the agent ticks it.

rules.label: Children in the apartment
rules.why: 'Check one.' The application answers it, so an empty pair means the applicant was never asked or the answer did not arrive.

rules.label: Renters insurance required or not
rules.why: The clause reads 'Renters insurance __ IS or __ IS NOT required'. Neither ticked leaves the obligation undefined.

rules.label: Smoking in the unit
rules.why: 'Smoking __ IS or __ IS NOT allowed in the Unit.' The lease later calls a breach of it material, so it has to say which.

rules.label: Other smoking restrictions
rules.why: The box is ticked next to 'Other areas/exceptions:' with nothing written after it.

rules.label: Subject to Good Cause Eviction
rules.why: The notice exists to answer this one question. Unanswered, it informs the tenant of nothing.

rules.label: Why the unit is exempt
rules.why: Saying the unit is not covered without saying why is the half of the answer a tenant can challenge.

rules.label: Rent increase against the threshold
rules.why: A covered unit has to state whether the rent crosses the presumptively unreasonable threshold.

rules.label: Justification for the increase
rules.why: Above the threshold the landlord must give a justification; the line is otherwise blank.

rules.label: Reason a lease is not being renewed
rules.why: For a first lease the right answer is the one saying no reason is needed. Left empty the section reads as an unanswered question.

rules.label: Attorneys' fees cap
rules.why: 'shall not exceed ____, excluding costs' with no figure caps nothing while looking as though it does.

rules.label: Attorneys' fees cap left over
rules.why: A figure prints into a sentence that begins 'If checkbox is selected' while the checkbox is not.

rules.label: Other utility (1)
rules.why: The addendum prints a row per utility. A payer with no utility named puts somebody on the hook for a blank.

rules.label: Other utility (2)
rules.why: As above, for the second spare row.
